title: London Trams service map
author: Transport for London
license_observation: Copyright TfL is printed in the map; no permission grant was observed. This is a preserved research reference, not an assertion of a redistribution license.
figure: Single-page tram service map, Version A 09.2024, TfL 0181.08.24; whole page.
object_count_basis: Thirty-nine named stops. Route colors, interchange symbols, stop ticks, direction arrows, and the key are additional semantic marks.
reading_path: Follow the west-to-east Wimbledon line into the one-way Croydon loop, then distinguish branches to Beckenham Junction, Elmers End, and New Addington. Interchange symbols qualify named stops.
merit: Consistent octilinear geometry, clear green route identities, alternating exterior labels, a careful Croydon loop, and terse interchange symbols make a large network readable at modest publication size.
preview_note: Actual single-page PDF retained. Preview rasterized proportionally with pdftoppm at a 1800-pixel-long edge.
